'''Corintium''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on [[Pirik]].

The [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Pirik was named [[Corint City]], probably as a reference to Corintium.
